files.description: The entire EHI export documentation page. A single-paragraph HTML page stating that MedicsCloud exports in HL7 CCDA XML and FHIR US Core STU3.1.1 format complying with USCDI v1. Contains no data dictionary, schema, API docs, or user guide — only links to external HL7 standards.

Browser screenshot of the B10 documentation page showing the full rendered content: vendor name, product version, one paragraph about CCDA/FHIR US Core export, and two links to external HL7 standards.
